title: What's New: Manufacturing Analytics (Updated Power BI App) Electronic Documents(2025 release wave 1)

features.name: Work Center Load Report
features.description: Updated report showing better visualization across work centers with color scheme of allocated time and available capacity, improved layout for multiple work centers, and detailed statistics table below.
caveats: embedded experience still being finished up
shown in raw Power BI rather than embedded

features.name: Expected Capacity Need Report
features.description: Enhanced report showing analytics and insights both by work center and machine center, with drill-down capability to order line level details.
caveats: drill-down to line level detail capability added

features.name: Finished Production Order Breakdown Report
features.description: Report updated with KPI focus and cost breakdown showing actual costs, capacity overhead cost, and overhead cost associated with production orders.

features.name: Work Center Statistics Report
features.description: New statistical report migrated from legacy manufacturing reports showing detailed work center statistics including capacity in minutes.
caveats: capacity units in minutes but customizable via Power BI file access
table-like format from legacy report migration

features.name: Machine Center Statistics Report
features.description: New statistical report showing machine center statistics including allocated time, center output, scrap, scrap percentage, and stop time.
caveats: requires scrolling to see all measures

features.name: Production Order Routing Lines Gantt Chart
features.description: New visual report displaying production order lines or routing lines in Gantt chart format with interactive timeline view and focus mode capability.
caveats: data refreshed in Power BI report

features.name: Manufacturing Power BI App Update
features.description: Comprehensive update to manufacturing Power BI app incorporating feedback from subject matter experts and partner community, modernizing legacy reports and adding Power BI specific visualizations.
caveats: embedded experience still being finished up at time of recording

features.name: Current Utilization Report Deprecation
features.description: Current utilization report will be hidden in version 26.1 and removed in a later release as part of the manufacturing Power BI app modernization.
caveats: deprecation is planned but not yet certain

features.name: Historical Utilization Report Deprecation
features.description: Historical utilization report will be hidden in version 26.1 and removed in a later release as part of the manufacturing Power BI app modernization.
caveats: deprecation is planned but not yet certain
